mapper.select: /* PushTargetMapper.selectNodeAdminChainUserCds */ WITH RECURSIVE anc AS ( SELECT N.NODE_CD, N.PARENT_NODE_CD, N.MAIN_ADMIN_CD, N.SUB_ADMIN_CD FROM TB_SITE_NODE N WHERE N.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND N.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND N.NODE_CD = #{nodeCd} UNION ALL SELECT P.NODE_CD, P.PARENT_NODE_CD, P.MAIN_ADMIN_CD, P.SUB_ADMIN_CD FROM TB_SITE_NODE P JOIN anc A2 ON P.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND P.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND P.NODE_CD = A2.PARENT_NODE_CD ) SELECT DISTINCT U.USER_CD FROM ( SELECT MAIN_ADMIN_CD AS ADMIN_CD FROM anc UNION SELECT SUB_ADMIN_CD AS ADMIN_CD FROM anc ) A INNER JOIN TB_USER U ON U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.USER_CD = A.ADMIN_CD WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(A.ADMIN_CD), '') IS NOT NULL AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND U.ACCOUNT_STATUS = '01'
